variants.headline: State payments fall short
variants.body: State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Equal cuts, different household needs
variants.body: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Treasury pays less than it owes
variants.body: Government payments have fallen short across state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions alike. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
